input: Organize a potluck dinner for my book club

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing whether this includes just coordinating food assignments or also venue setup, book discussion agenda, decorations, and invitations changes the full scope of the plan.
The number of attendees and any dietary restrictions or allergies directly shapes how food contributions are divided and what dishes are appropriate.
The date, time, and hosting location determine urgency of planning, whether a venue needs to be arranged, and logistical details like kitchen access.
A budget limit affects whether supplementary items (drinks, plates, decorations) need to be crowdsourced or purchased centrally, and how elaborate the event can be.
A theme (tied to the book being discussed, a cuisine type, etc.) would shape dish assignments, invitations, and the overall feel of the event.
The tool or method used to coordinate dish sign-ups (group chat, shared doc, a sign-up app) determines the immediate next action and how communication flows.
Understanding what the user considers a successful event — balanced meal variety, full attendance, a certain atmosphere — helps prioritize which planning steps matter most.

gold.taskTitle: Organize a potluck dinner for book club
gold.taskDescription: Plan and coordinate a potluck dinner event for the user's book club, covering logistics, guest needs, and food contributions.

questions.title: How many people are you expecting to attend?
questions.description: Establish the headcount to determine how many dish contributions are needed and how to divide food categories.

questions.title: Does the event have a set date and location yet?
questions.description: Determine whether a venue and time are already fixed or still need to be decided, which affects planning urgency.

questions.title: What does organizing this include beyond coordinating food?
questions.description: Clarify whether the plan should also cover invitations, setup, a book discussion agenda, or decorations.

questions.title: Are there any dietary restrictions or allergies to accommodate?
questions.description: Identify any food constraints among attendees that must be factored into dish assignments.

questions.title: Should the food or event follow a specific theme?
questions.description: Find out if there is a theme tied to the current book, a cuisine type, or a season that should guide dish choices.

questions.title: How do you plan to coordinate dish sign-ups with members?
questions.description: Determine the communication tool or method (group chat, spreadsheet, sign-up app) to use for assigning contributions.

questions.title: What would make this potluck feel like a success to you?
questions.description: Understand the user's top priority — full attendance, a balanced spread, a relaxed atmosphere, etc. — to focus the plan accordingly.
